en.headline: Observatory issues Red Fire Danger Warning as risk reaches extreme
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Red Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Saturday, warning that the countryside is extremely vulnerable to fire.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Red Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Saturday, stating that the fire risk is extreme.

The Observatory said the countryside is extremely vulnerable to fire. It advised people planning to spend the day outdoors to take pre-cooked food for picnics and to take all measures to prevent hill fires. The penalty for lighting fires illegally in the countryside is HK$25,000 and a year's imprisonment.

The warning remains in force. The Observatory also cancelled the Cold Weather Warning at the same time on Saturday morning. Current conditions at the Observatory show an air temperature of about 20 degrees Celsius with relative humidity around 45 per cent.

zh.headline: 天文台發出紅色火災危險警告 火險極高
zh.dek: 香港天文台於周六上午六時發出紅色火災危險警告，指郊野火險極高，市民外出需採取防火措施。
body: 香港天文台周六上午六時發出紅色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性極高。
天文台指郊野極易發生火災。市民如計劃外出，應携帶預先煮好的食物，並採取一切措施防止山火。在郊野非法生火，可被罰款二萬五千元及監禁一年。
警告現時仍然生效。天文台同時於周六上午取消寒冷天氣警告。天文台目前氣溫約攝氏20度，相對濕度約百分之45。
